scope: Historical Windows-native scheduler-owner checks A on 2026-11-26. The reported test outcomes belong to the pinned source input of each executed command.
receipt_basis: Run names are relative to runs/. Actual status, process result and closure come from receipt.json and root-receiving.json. Each config hash was matched against the receipt before reading expectations or identifying later commands that did not run. Every measured stdout/stderr SHA-256 and byte count was recomputed from the capture. Controller capture hashes are independently computed. Each command's native_io_receiving key identifies its original job, deadline and reader closure fields.
source_pin_method: A source snapshot maps repository-relative paths to SHA-256 from the receipt step_inputs. Its key hashes the sorted compact JSON map. Negative-control argv names the overlay. The checkout pins do not bind the overlay bytes.
go_count_method: Go JSON pass/fail/skip events are counted for roots and slash-qualified subtests separately. A started test lacking a terminal event is listed by name. notrun counts unstarted explicitly selected roots for finite anchored selectors. A null count means the total cannot be recovered from these captures, including wildcard selectors and dynamically discovered subtests. Package failure is independent of test-event counts.
argv_normalization: Executable paths are recorded by basename. Qualification workspace paths in argv are relative to the qualification root. Selectors, timeout flags, tags and other arguments are retained.
